description: Tasks flagged for human review as candidates for the multi-agent shared-canvas benchmark. Flags are proposals, not accepted saves.
criterion: The task naturally decomposes into two or more concurrent regions, layers, tracks, views, or components of one shared artifact, while requiring global visual, spatial, or temporal coherence.
exclusions: PPT-Eval tasks already reviewed by the user
Sequential multi-step work without concurrent region ownership
Parallel work across separate artifacts or applications only
Tasks without enough public metadata to infer a defensible decomposition
Tasks whose public instruction contains Chinese-language text, excluded because the reviewer requested an English-only approval queue
